mapper.sql: select c.commit_id, c.title, c.scope_type, c.deadline, c.status, c.person_id, c.person_name, c.sign_time, c.record_type, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from jc_edu_commitment c
mapper.select: select c.commit_id, c.title, c.content, c.scope_type, c.deadline, c.status, c.person_id, c.person_name, c.sign_time, c.record_type, c.create_by, c.create_time, c.update_by, c.update_time, c.remark from jc_edu_commitment c where c.commit_id = #{commitId} and c.del_flag = '0'
where c.status = '1' and c.record_type = '0' and c.del_flag = '0' order by c.create_time desc
mapper.update:
update jc_edu_commitment
title = #{title}, content = #{content}, scope_type = #{scopeType}, deadline = #{deadline}, status = #{status}, remark = #{remark}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now()
where commit_id = #{commitId} and record_type = '0'
update jc_edu_commitment set status = '1', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where commit_id = #{commitId} and status = '0' and record_type = '0'
update jc_edu_commitment set status = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where commit_id = #{commitId} and status = '1' and record_type = '0'
